answer: A reputation system anchored to a refundable stake works like a jetty: new agents enter through one narrow, rate-limited channel and must lock a deposit, an anchor tying their identity to real cost. Trust then grows like a vine along verified work, each honest job adding a tendril, and cheating prunes it. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and slowly grow history for every fake identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes plus months of honest work, while one honest agent pays once.
